title: Microsoft Purview: scan existing SharePoint and OneDrive files for sensitive information (GCC, GCC High, DoD)
summary: Hold: the checklist sends administrators to Usage center to compare the billed amount, but Microsoft documents consumption units there and charges on the Azure bill. The roadmap facts, scan settings, commands and billing meter are supported; two control paths also stop short of their settings.
